businessModel: Volunteer project; donations. No ads or paid tiers
updateCadence: Irregular; gz83 has shipped M150, M151, M152, M154 and M156 between Jul and Oct 2026
summary: A performance-tuned Chromium fork (AVX/AVX2/SSE builds, PGO/LTO) with extra codecs and Manifest V2 uBlock Origin preinstalled. Maintainer continuity is the main risk: gz83 has been shipping unofficial-beta builds since mid-2026.
bestFor: Chromium users who want MV2 uBlock Origin to keep working
Linux, Windows, macOS and Android users who want a de-Googled-ish Chromium
notFor: Anyone needing guaranteed same-week security patches
Users who need a clearly staffed project

pros.title: MV2 extensions kept
pros.detail: Release notes say uBlock Origin 1.75.0 is preinstalled and MV2 support is retained, unlike stock Chrome.

pros.title: CPU-optimized builds
pros.detail: Separate SSE3/SSE4/AVX/AVX2 (and AVX-512 on Linux) builds with PGO and LTO.

pros.title: Wide platform reach
pros.detail: Windows, Linux (deb/rpm/ARM64), macOS 13+, Android, Raspberry Pi and Windows-on-ARM builds.

pros.title: Extra codecs
pros.detail: Proprietary codecs such as H.264 and HEVC are enabled, with hardware decode.

pros.title: Full Chromium compatibility
pros.detail: Blink engine and Chrome Web Store access keep site compatibility at Chrome level.

cons.title: Maintainer uncertainty
cons.detail: Alex313031 has been unavailable; gz83 builds are labelled Beta because they are not officially released.

cons.title: Patch lag and trust
cons.detail: Unofficial third-party binaries trail Chrome and have a smaller security team than Chrome or Brave.

cons.title: No built-in sync
cons.detail: Google Sync is not available in the builds (not confirmed in the release notes).

cons.title: MV2 durability
cons.detail: Keeping MV2 requires patching around Chromium 150+ removal code each release.

signatureFeatures: Multi-platform incl. Android and Raspberry Pi

faq.a: Yes, but by interim maintainer gz83; builds since M144 (June 2026) are posted on his fork as Beta while original author Alex313031 is unavailable.

faq.q: Does Thorium still support uBlock Origin?
faq.a: Yes. Release notes say MV2 support is kept and uBO 1.75.0 is preinstalled, though community reports on MV2 beyond M150 are mixed.

faq.q: Does it still run on Windows 7?
faq.a: The M150 notes say old Windows 7 files were removed; Windows 7 builds ended with the earlier M138 line.
